candidate.definition_en: To turn into ice; to preserve food by chilling it below zero; or to stop moving suddenly.
candidate.explanation_ar: المية تتحول لتلج، أو تثبت مكانك وماتتحركش خالص.

senses.definition_en: To turn into ice or preserve food at a temperature below freezing.
senses.definition_ar: يتجمد أو يجمد الطعام بحفظه في درجات حرارة منخفضة جداً.
examples: You can freeze the leftover food.

senses.definition_en: To suddenly stop moving and stay completely still, especially because of fear or surprise.
senses.definition_ar: يتسمر في مكانه أو يتوقف فجأة عن الحركة بسبب الخوف أو المفاجأة.
examples: Fear made him freeze in his tracks.

senses.definition_en: To officially stop or restrict access to money, accounts, or assets.
senses.definition_ar: يجمد حساباً مصرفياً أو أصولاً مالية ويمنع التصرف فيها.
examples: The bank decided to freeze the account due to suspicious activity.
You can freeze the leftover food.
Fear made him freeze in his tracks.
The bank decided to freeze the account due to suspicious activity.
